newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco withdraww 124 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco withdraww 124 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: The Moroccan Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 124 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction on Wednesday, a bank official said.
The bank said it received bids totalling 2.980 billion dirhams and allocated 2.760 billion dirhams at a 7.0 percent interest rate for one week.
The amount allocated was less than 2.884 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, it said.
The bank satisfied 92.62 percent of demand.
The next auction is due to be held on October 2, 1996.
